annotations.title: Net salary: Spain vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in Spain (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

beckham.description: Beckham regime (inbound worker). Flat 24% on Spanish employment income up to €600,000 for six years. Default false.

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in Spain, in EUR

joint.description: Joint return with spouse (no income of their own) Default false.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

region.description: Region. Basque Country and Navarre run their own tax systems and are not covered.: madrid = Madrid; catalonia = Catalonia (Barcelona); andalusia = Andalusia (Málaga, Seville); valencia = Valencia (Alicante). Default madrid.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in EUR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

name: compare_with_netherlands
title: Net salary: Spain vs the Netherlands
